papers.title: Designing infection prevalence and seroprevalence surveys for learning infection dynamics
papers.translated_title: 设计感染流行率和血清流行率调查以了解感染动态
papers.author: Creswell, R.
papers.summary: Knowledge of the true number of infections over time is valuable for accurately predicting the future course of an epidemic and planning effective interventions, but the number of cases reported offers only a noisy underestimate of the true number of infections. Disease surveillance strategies based on assessing subsets of the population for current infection (infection prevalence surveys) or antibody presence (seroprevalence surveys) yield crucial information about the number truly infected, but are expensive. To explore impact of survey design considerations--both sample size and sampling frequency--on inference of the number of incident infections over time, we coupled agent-based simulations of respiratory virus epidemics with simulations of infection prevalence and seroprevalence surveys. While returns diminish with increased sample size, we find inference generally improved by increasing survey frequency relative to participants-per-round for any given sample size. After survey rounds reach a sufficient frequency, comparable inference performance may be achieved with either more frequent rounds or more participants per round. Rolling designs with tests conducted each day tend to outperform designs in which testing is divided into discrete rounds. We also show that misspecified assumptions about seroreversion may substantially decrease the quality of inference results.
papers.translated_summary: 了解随时间变化的真实感染人数对于准确预测疫情的未来走向和规划有效干预措施具有重要价值，但报告的病例数只是对真实感染人数的嘈杂低估。基于评估人群子集当前感染状况（感染流行率调查）或抗体存在情况（血清流行率调查）的疾病监测策略，能够提供关于真实感染人数的关键信息，但成本高昂。为探究调查设计考量因素——包括样本量和采样频率——对随时间推移的新发感染人数推断的影响，我们将呼吸道病毒疫情的基于个体的模拟与感染流行率和血清流行率调查的模拟相结合。尽管随着样本量增加收益递减，但我们发现，对于任何给定样本量，相对于每轮参与者数量而言，提高调查频率通常能改善推断效果。在调查轮次达到足够频率后，无论是更频繁的轮次还是每轮更多参与者，均可实现相当的推断性能。每天进行检测的滚动设计往往优于将检测划分为离散轮次的设计。我们还表明，关于血清逆转的错误设定假设可能会大幅降低推断结果的质量。

papers.title: Validity and reliability of the Japanese version of the Movement Behaviour Questionnaire-Child (MBQ-C) for assessing active play, screen time, and sleep in preschool children
papers.translated_title: 日本版儿童运动行为问卷（MBQ-C）在评估学龄前儿童活跃游戏、屏幕时间和睡眠方面的效度和信度
papers.author: Komura, K.
papers.summary: Background: Valid and feasible measures of preschoolers' 24-hour movement behaviours are needed for population-level research. We developed a Japanese version of the Movement Behaviour Questionnaire-Child (MBQ-C) and evaluated its measurement properties and practicality. Methods: After translation and cross-cultural adaptation following the COSMIN procedure, including cognitive interviews, we evaluated the questionnaire in a cross-sectional validation study of Japanese children aged 3-6 years. Concurrent validity was assessed against hip-worn accelerometry and a 7-day diary; we also examined test-retest reliability, measurement error, agreement between response formats and modes, and practicality (completion time, burden, and clarity). Analyses used Spearman correlations, intraclass correlation coefficients, the SEM, smallest detectable change (SDC), and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Results: Of 208 children, 170 provided valid accelerometer and diary data for the concurrent-validity analysis, and 187 completed the MBQ-C for the questionnaire-based analyses. Concurrent validity was weak for active and energetic play (Spearman {rho} = 0.12-0.26), strong for total screen time (0.78-0.85), and moderate for total sleep (0.48-0.58). Test-retest reliability was moderate to good (ICC, 0.66-0.81), and within-child variability was lowest for sleep (CV 3%) and highest for the physical activity items (21-33%). The open- and closed-ended versions showed no significant differences; paper-electronic agreement was good for screen time and sleep but poor for active play. Completion took approximately 6-9 minutes, with low reported burden. Findings were robust in sensitivity analyses. At the group level, SDC for a mean was SDCind/{surd}N: 119.8/{surd}N, 74.0/{surd}N, 112.6/{surd}N, and 92.5/{surd}N min/day for active play, energetic play, total screen time, and total sleep, respectively (N = number of children surveyed). The systematic differences between the two test-retest occasions were +15.7, +6.5, +4.0, and -5.4 min/day, respectively. Conclusions: The Japanese MBQ-C is a practical option for assessing preschoolers' active play, screen time, and sleep at the group level. By quantifying its group-level measurement error, this study provides benchmarks for interpreting group-level differences and change, supporting the use of the MBQ-C in surveillance and evaluation of programmes delivered at scale.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：需要在人群层面研究中采用有效且可行的学龄前儿童24小时运动行为测量工具。我们开发了日文版儿童运动行为问卷（MBQ-C），并评估了其测量学特性与实用性。方法：按照COSMIN程序进行翻译和跨文化调适（包括认知访谈）后，我们在3-6岁日本儿童中开展横断面验证研究评估该问卷。以髋部佩戴加速度计和7天日记评估同时效度；同时检验重测信度、测量误差、作答格式与施测方式之间的一致性以及实用性（完成时间、负担和清晰度）。分析采用Spearman相关、组内相关系数、SEM、最小可检测变化（SDC）和Wilcoxon符号秩检验。结果：在208名儿童中，170名提供了用于同时效度分析的有效加速度计和日记数据，187名完成了MBQ-C以用于基于问卷的分析。同时效度在活跃游戏和剧烈游戏方面较弱（Spearman ρ = 0.12-0.26），在总屏幕时间方面较强（0.78-0.85），在总睡眠时间方面为中等（0.48-0.58）。重测信度为中等至良好（ICC，0.66-0.81），儿童内变异以睡眠最低（CV 3%），以身体活动条目最高（21-33%）。开放式与封闭式版本之间无显著差异；纸笔与电子版一致性在屏幕时间和睡眠方面良好，但在活跃游戏方面较差。完成时间约为6-9分钟，报告的负担较低。敏感性分析结果稳健。在群体层面，均值的SDC为SDCind/√N：活跃游戏、剧烈游戏、总屏幕时间和总睡眠分别为119.8/√N、74.0/√N、112.6/√N和92.5/√N分钟/天（N = 接受调查的儿童数）。两次重测之间的系统差异分别为+15.7、+6.5、+4.0和-5.4分钟/天。结论：日文版MBQ-C是在群体层面评估学龄前儿童活跃游戏、屏幕时间和睡眠的实用选择。通过量化其群体层面测量误差，本研究为解释群体层面差异和变化提供了基准，支持将MBQ-C用于监测和大规模实施项目的评估。

papers.title: Nicotine pouch adverts reach 12 times more young men than women: targeting and reach on Meta social media platforms in the UK
papers.translated_title: 尼古丁袋广告触达的年轻男性是女性的12倍：英国Meta社交媒体平台上的定向投放与触达范围
papers.author: Sun, H.
papers.summary: Abstract Aims To examine which demographic groups nicotine pouch advertisers chose to target on social media, and which groups Meta's algorithms actually delivered the adverts to. Design Cross-sectional analysis of advert-level data from the Meta Ad Library. Setting Meta social media platforms (including Facebook and Instagram) in the UK. Cases A sample of 642 nicotine pouch adverts identified by keyword search, shown in the 12 months up to December 2025, and a comparison sample of 1,125 general adverts. Analyses of reach were restricted to adverts with no advertiser-set gender restriction that targeted all adult ages (373 pouch adverts; 674 general). Measurements Outcomes, both extracted from the Meta Ad Library, were advertiser-set gender and age-group targeting criteria (i.e., groups eligible to be shown each advert) and estimated advert reach to each group (i.e., number of people who saw each advert). Male-to-female reach ratios (RR) within age groups, and reach ratios comparing age groups, were calculated per advert and summarised using geometric means. To assess whether patterns were pouch-specific, comparisons with general adverts were made using ratios of reach ratios (RRR). Findings Advertisers of nicotine pouches targeted a broad sample. Most adverts 81.0% (520/642) had no gender restriction, the remainder were restricted to men only. All were restricted to adults (minimum age 18 years) and most (96.9%; 622/642) had no upper age limit. Despite this, of pouch adverts eligible to be shown to all adults, adverts were more likely to reach men, particularly among younger men. Among 18-24-year-olds, pouch adverts reached around twelve times as many men as women (RR 12.5, 95% CI 10.9-14.4), compared with a slight skew towards women for general adverts (RR 0.81, 95% CI 0.70-0.95), corresponding to an RRR of 15.4 (95% CI 12.3-18.8). Pouch adverts also showed a skew in reach towards younger age groups. Relative to those aged 35-44 years, reach was higher among 18-24-year-olds for nicotine pouch adverts (RR 1.50, 95% CI 1.31-1.71) but much lower for general adverts (RR 0.19, 95% CI 0.17-0.21), corresponding to an RRR of 7.9 (95% CI 6.6-9.5). Conclusions Nicotine pouch adverts on social media were often eligible to be shown broadly to all demographic groups but were disproportionately delivered to young men.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 目的 考察尼古丁袋广告商在社交媒体上选择定位哪些人口群体，以及Meta的算法实际将广告投放给了哪些群体。设计 对Meta广告库中广告层面数据的横断面分析。背景 英国的Meta社交媒体平台（包括Facebook和Instagram）。案例 通过关键词搜索识别出的642条尼古丁袋广告样本，展示时间为截至2025年12月的12个月内，以及1125条一般广告的对照样本。触达分析仅限于未设置广告商性别限制且面向所有成年人年龄段的广告（373条尼古丁袋广告；674条一般广告）。测量指标 结果均提取自Meta广告库，包括广告商设置的性别和年龄组定位标准（即有资格看到每条广告的群体）以及每条广告对各群体的估计触达人数（即看到每条广告的人数）。计算各年龄组内男性与女性的触达比（RR），以及比较各年龄组的触达比，并使用几何均值进行汇总。为评估这些模式是否为尼古丁袋广告所特有，使用触达比的比值（RRR）与一般广告进行比较。发现 尼古丁袋广告商定位了广泛的样本。大多数广告81.0%（520/642）没有性别限制，其余仅限男性。所有广告均限制为成年人（最低年龄18岁），大多数（96.9%；622/642）没有年龄上限。尽管如此，在有资格向所有成年人展示的尼古丁袋广告中，广告更可能触达男性，尤其是年轻男性。在18-24岁人群中，尼古丁袋广告触达的男性约为女性的十二倍（RR 12.5，95% CI 10.9-14.4），而一般广告则略微偏向女性（RR 0.81，95% CI 0.70-0.95），对应的RRR为15.4（95% CI 12.3-18.8）。尼古丁袋广告的触达也呈现偏向年轻年龄组的趋势。相对于35-44岁人群，尼古丁袋广告在18-24岁人群中的触达更高（RR 1.50，95% CI 1.31-1.71），而一般广告则低得多（RR 0.19，95% CI 0.17-0.21），对应的RRR为7.9（95% CI 6.6-9.5）。结论 社交媒体上的尼古丁袋广告通常有资格广泛展示给所有人口群体，但却不成比例地投放给了年轻男性。

papers.title: Analysing Spatial and Temporal Concept Drift in Forecasting Malnutrition Admissions in Kenya
papers.translated_title: 分析肯尼亚营养不良入院人数预测中的时空概念漂移
papers.author: Squires, S.
papers.summary: Forecasting malnutrition admissions could support anticipatory planning in health systems, but existing machine learning and statistical approaches have struggled to produce forecasts of practical value. We investigate whether this disappointing performance is partly attributable to spatial and temporal concept drift, whereby relationships between predictors and admissions differ by location and over time, respectively. We also examine whether adaptations to the modelling approach can mitigate these effects. We used malnutrition admissions from 44 subcounties across 14 counties in Kenya between 2015 and 2020, alongside potential predictors including normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) and rainfall. We conducted univariate, multivariate, and non-linear analyses of spatial and temporal concept drift, and then trained machine learning (ML) forecasting models using adaptations intended to mitigate these drifts. We find substantial spatial and temporal variation in relationships between predictors and admissions. For temporal concept drift in one subcounty the maximum correlation between admissions and time-lagged admissions for different time periods ranged from -0.39 (95% CIs: -0.74 to -0.04) to 0.45 (95% CIs: 0.11 to 0.79); the equivalents for changes between subcounties ranged from a minimum to maximum of -0.18 (95% CIs: -0.45 to 0.09) to 0.64 (95% CIs: 0.43 to 0.85). For non-linear models, there are also substantial changes in feature importance. At a forecast horizon of three months, our best-performing ML model produced a root mean squared error of 1.07 (95% CIs: 0.96 to 1.18), significantly outperforming the best baseline of 1.23 (95% CIs: 1.10 to 1.39); however, the predictions are unlikely to be sufficiently accurate for practical use. These findings suggest that spatial and temporal concept drift should be explicitly considered when developing forecasting models for malnutrition admissions, rather than relying directly on off-the-shelf ML approaches.
papers.translated_summary: 预测营养不良入院情况可为卫生系统的前瞻性规划提供支持，但现有的机器学习和统计方法难以产生具有实用价值的预测。我们研究这种令人失望的表现是否部分归因于空间和时间概念漂移，即预测变量与入院情况之间的关系分别因地点和时间而异。我们还检验了对建模方法的调整能否缓解这些影响。我们使用了肯尼亚14个县44个次县2015年至2020年的营养不良入院数据，以及包括归一化差异植被指数（NDVI）和降雨量在内的潜在预测变量。我们对空间和时间概念漂移进行了单变量、多变量和非线性分析，然后使用旨在缓解这些漂移的调整方法训练了机器学习（ML）预测模型。我们发现预测变量与入院情况之间的关系存在显著的空间和时间变异。对于某一个次县的时间概念漂移，不同时间段入院情况与时间滞后入院情况之间的最大相关性从-0.39（95%置信区间：-0.74至-0.04）到0.45（95%置信区间：0.11至0.79）不等；次县之间变化的对应值从最小值到最大值分别为-0.18（95%置信区间：-0.45至0.09）到0.64（95%置信区间：0.43至0.85）。对于非线性模型，特征重要性也存在显著变化。在三个月的预测期上，我们表现最佳的ML模型产生的均方根误差为1.07（95%置信区间：0.96至1.18），显著优于最佳基线模型的1.23（95%置信区间：1.10至1.39）；然而，这些预测不太可能足够准确以供实际使用。这些发现表明，在开发营养不良入院预测模型时，应明确考虑空间和时间概念漂移，而不是直接依赖现成的ML方法。

papers.title: Plasma Proteogenomic Uncovers Novel Molecular Mechanisms of Soluble Endoglin and Identifies AZI2 as a new Player in Arteriovenous Malformations in Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia
papers.translated_title: 血浆蛋白质组学揭示了可溶性内皮糖蛋白的新分子机制，并将AZI2鉴定为遗传性出血性毛细血管扩张症中动静脉畸形的新参与者
papers.author: Munsch, G.
papers.summary: Endoglin is a transmembrane glycoprotein that plays a key role in vascular development, angiogenesis and endothelial homeostasis. Its soluble form (Sol-ENG), generated through proteolytic shedding of the membrane-bound protein, has been implicated in the pathophysiology of numerous cardiovascular diseases, ranging from common conditions such as preeclampsia and thrombosis to rare diseases such as hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia (HHT). Leveraging large-scale genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and metabolomics data from public and original resources, we identify a molecular signature of 24 markers associated with plasma levels of Sol-ENG. This signature was enriched in genes coding for GPI-enchored proteins and included metabolites participating to glycosylation and redox homeostasis. Furthermore, we observed that ABO blood groups and genetically predicted plasma levels of 5-Azacytidine Induced 2 (AZI2) associate with the risk of arteriovenous malformations in HHT patients. This study provides new insights into the physiological mechanisms underlying Endoglin regulation and opens clinical perspectives for the management of HHT patients.
papers.translated_summary: Endoglin是一种跨膜糖蛋白，在血管发育、血管生成和内皮稳态中发挥关键作用。其可溶性形式（Sol-ENG）由膜结合蛋白经蛋白水解脱落产生，已被认为与众多心血管疾病的病理生理学相关，从子痫前期和血栓形成等常见病症到遗传性出血性毛细血管扩张症（HHT）等罕见疾病。利用来自公共和原始资源的大规模基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学数据，我们鉴定出与血浆Sol-ENG水平相关的24个标志物的分子特征。该特征富集于编码GPI锚定蛋白的基因，并包括参与糖基化和氧化还原稳态的代谢物。此外，我们观察到ABO血型和遗传预测的血浆5-氮杂胞苷诱导2（AZI2）水平与HHT患者动静脉畸形的风险相关。本研究为Endoglin调控的生理机制提供了新见解，并为HHT患者的管理开辟了临床前景。

papers.title: Prevalence of sarcopenia and frailty in mobility-limited older adults: the cross-sectional BIOFRAIL cohort study
papers.translated_title: 行动受限老年人中肌肉减少症和衰弱的患病率：横断面BIOFRAIL队列研究
papers.author: Hansen, P.
papers.summary: Abstract Background: Sarcopenia and frailty pose considerable risks to older adults due to their close association with reduced physical performance, increased risks of falls, and mortality. Despite this, knowledge about the prevalence in mobility-limited older adults remains scarce. Therefore, we aimed to identify the prevalence and co-prevalence of sarcopenia and frailty in mobility-limited older adults. Methods: This cross-sectional study included patients aged [≥]65 years referred to a geriatric outpatient clinic for fall assessment. Sarcopenia risk was screened using SARC-F and defined according to the European Working Group on Sarcopenia in Older People criteria; frailty was evaluated using the Clinical Frailty Scale. Muscle strength was assessed by handgrip strength and the 30-second sit-to-stand test. Skeletal muscle index was determined using bioelectrical impedance analysis (Inbody770). Gait speed was assessed over 6 meters. Results: A total of 375 patients (mean age 79.7 {+/-} 6.1 years; 65% female) were included, with 28.0% demonstrating low HGS and 36.8% showing low STS performance, while only 13.9% demonstrated concurrent impairments in both tests. Low SMI was observed in 25.1% of the patients. The prevalence of sarcopenia was 14.1%, frailty 23.7%, and their co-prevalence 7.2%. Conclusions: In mobility-limited older adults referred for fall assessment, sarcopenia and frailty were common conditions showing only limited overlap. The low co-prevalence between HGS and STS underscores the importance of using multiple strength assessments, while the substantial prevalence of low muscle mass highlights the need for routine muscle mass evaluation regardless of muscle strength status. Trial registration: NCT05795556
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景：肌少症和衰弱对老年人构成相当大的风险，因为它们与身体活动能力下降、跌倒风险增加和死亡率密切相关。尽管如此，关于活动能力受限的老年人中其患病率的知识仍然匮乏。因此，我们旨在确定活动能力受限的老年人中肌少症和衰弱的患病率及共患病率。方法：本横断面研究纳入年龄≥65岁、转诊至老年门诊进行跌倒评估的患者。肌少症风险采用SARC-F进行筛查，并根据欧洲老年人肌少症工作组标准进行定义；衰弱采用临床衰弱量表进行评估。肌肉力量通过握力和30秒坐立试验进行评估。骨骼肌指数采用生物电阻抗分析（Inbody770）测定。步速评估距离为6米。结果：共纳入375例患者（平均年龄79.7±6.1岁；65%为女性），其中28.0%表现为低握力，36.8%表现为低坐立试验表现，而仅13.9%在两项测试中同时存在损害。25.1%的患者观察到低骨骼肌指数。肌少症患病率为14.1%，衰弱为23.7%，二者共患病率为7.2%。结论：在因跌倒评估而转诊的活动能力受限的老年人中，肌少症和衰弱是常见疾病，但重叠有限。握力与坐立试验之间较低的共患病率凸显了采用多种力量评估的重要性，而低肌肉量的较高患病率则强调无论肌肉力量状态如何均需进行常规肌肉量评估。试验注册：NCT05795556

papers.title: An ICD-10-based algorithm for identifying the cause of acute respiratory failure in mechanically ventilated patients
papers.translated_title: 一种基于ICD-10的算法，用于识别机械通气患者急性呼吸衰竭的病因
papers.author: Kahn, J. M.
papers.summary: Rationale: Acute respiratory failure requiring invasive mechanical ventilation is a common reason for admission to an intensive care unit. Epidemiological research is limited by the lack of scalable approaches for identifying the primary cause of acute respiratory failure in these patients. Objective: To develop and validate an algorithm for classifying mechanically ventilated patients by the primary cause of acute respiratory failure using International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) diagnosis and procedure codes. Methods: We identified adult patients undergoing invasive mechanical ventilation in the electronic health record of a multi-hospital health system in the United States. Using this cohort, we created a preliminary classification schema that assigned patients to one of eight mutually exclusive causes of acute respiratory failure (stroke, chronic lung disease, heart failure, trauma or overdose, pneumonia, non-pneumonia sepsis, post-operative, and other) based on the presence or absence of pre-specified ICD-10 codes. We compared the preliminary classifications to a clinical reference standard ascertained via manual chart review in a stratified random sample of the development cohort, refining the schema to optimize concordance. We then assessed content validity by examining clinical characteristics and outcomes across diagnosis categories, both in the development cohort and in an external all-payer claims dataset. Results: Of 8,130 hospitalizations in the development sample, all were successfully categorized into eight mutually exclusive groups. Compared to the reference standard of manual chart review (n=206), overall agreement was moderate (kappa = 0.44, 95% confidence interval: 0.39-0.49). After refinement, overall agreement improved slightly (kappa = 0.46, 95% confidence interval: 0.41-0.52). The final positive predictive values ranged from 78.6% (pneumonia) to 32.3% (stroke). The largest diagnostic category was non-pneumonia sepsis (26.1%), and the smallest diagnostic category was heart failure (6.2%). Clinical characteristics and outcomes approximated those expected from prior literature and were similar in the external dataset. Conclusions: A novel ICD-10-based algorithm for determining the primary cause of acute respiratory failure in patients receiving invasive mechanical ventilation was moderately accurate. This algorithm is potentially useful for facilitating large-scale epidemiological research in this population.
papers.translated_summary: 理由：需要侵入性机械通气的急性呼吸衰竭是进入重症监护病房的常见原因。流行病学研究受到限制，原因是缺乏可扩展的方法来识别这些患者急性呼吸衰竭的主要原因。目的：开发并验证一种算法，利用国际疾病分类第十版（ICD-10）诊断和操作代码，按急性呼吸衰竭的主要原因对机械通气患者进行分类。方法：我们在美国一个多医院卫生系统的电子健康记录中识别了接受侵入性机械通气的成年患者。利用该队列，我们创建了一个初步分类方案，根据预先指定的ICD-10代码是否存在，将患者分配到八种互斥的急性呼吸衰竭原因之一（卒中、慢性肺病、心力衰竭、创伤或药物过量、肺炎、非肺炎性脓毒症、术后及其他）。我们将初步分类与通过在开发队列的分层随机样本中进行人工病历审查所确定的临床参考标准进行比较，并完善方案以优化一致性。随后，我们通过检查开发队列和外部全支付方索赔数据集中各诊断类别的临床特征和结局来评估内容效度。结果：在开发样本的8，130例住院中，所有住院均被成功归类为八个互斥组。与人工病历审查的参考标准（n=206）相比，总体一致性为中等（kappa = 0.44，95%置信区间：0.39-0.49）。完善后，总体一致性略有提高（kappa = 0.46，95%置信区间：0.41-0.52）。最终阳性预测值范围为78.6%（肺炎）至32.3%（卒中）。最大的诊断类别为非肺炎性脓毒症（26.1%），最小的诊断类别为心力衰竭（6.2%）。临床特征和结局与既往文献预期大致相符，并且在外部数据集中相似。结论：一种基于ICD-10的新算法用于确定接受侵入性机械通气患者急性呼吸衰竭的主要原因，具有中等准确性。该算法可能有助于促进该人群的大规模流行病学研究。

papers.title: Detection of Peanut Allergy Sensitization and Monitoring of Type 2 Memory B cells Using Recombinant Peanut Allergen Components
papers.translated_title: 使用重组花生过敏原组分检测花生过敏致敏及监测2型记忆B细胞
papers.author: Reinwald, S.
papers.summary: Background Peanut allergy is one of the most common causes of life-threatening food allergy, and therefore the focus of multiple clinical trials for allergen immunotherapy. Diagnosis relies on detection of allergen-specific serum IgE, which provides limited information on severity and threshold. Furthermore, objective biomarkers to predict allergic persistence and efficacy of treatment are lacking. Therefore, we aimed to incorporate recombinant peanut allergen components in a multiplex Cytometric Basophil detection assay (CytoBas) for detection of peanut sensitization, and in a memory B cell (Bmem) panel for evaluation of biomarkers of disease. Methods In 27 adult peanut-allergic patients, allergen-specific IgE levels were determined by ImmunoCAP, and component-specific IgE by ELISA. PBMC of all patients and of 15 non-sensitized controls were analyzed by flow cytometry with basophil markers and six fluorochrome-conjugated allergen component tetramers for CytoBas, while circulating Bmem were studied including fluorescent tetramers for Ara h 1, Ara h 2 and Ara h 3. Results CytoBas demonstrated similar-to-improved diagnostic performance compared to IgE ELISAs for Ara h -1, -2, -3, -6, -8 allergens (ROCs AUC 0.79-1.0 versus 0.78-0.9). Ara h 2 discriminated all patients from controls, while combined Ara h 1, 3 and 6 (excluding major allergen Ara h 2) elicited 78-81% sensitivity with 100% specificity. Peanut-allergic patients showed expansion of the pathogenic Type 2 Bmem subset within Ara h 1-, 2- and 3-specific cells, and the Ara h 1+ and Ara h 3+ Bmem contained expanded IgG4+ and IgG1 subsets. Conclusions Peanut CytoBas displays similar to superior diagnostic accuracy to component-specific IgE serology, enabling efficient evaluation of multiple allergen components in a single test tube. Peanut-allergic individuals show increased frequencies of allergen-specific type 2 Bmem, which could be longitudinally evaluated to monitor the natural course of disease or allergen immunotherapy.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 花生过敏是危及生命的食物过敏最常见的原因之一，因此成为多项过敏原免疫治疗临床试验的关注焦点。诊断依赖于检测过敏原特异性血清IgE，但其在严重程度和阈值方面提供的信息有限。此外，缺乏预测过敏持续性和治疗疗效的客观生物标志物。因此，我们旨在将重组花生过敏原组分纳入多重流式细胞术嗜碱性粒细胞检测（CytoBas）中以检测花生致敏，并纳入记忆B细胞（Bmem）panel以评估疾病生物标志物。方法 在27例成人花生过敏患者中，通过ImmunoCAP测定过敏原特异性IgE水平，通过ELISA测定组分特异性IgE。对所有患者及15名非致敏对照者的PBMC，使用嗜碱性粒细胞标志物和六种荧光染料偶联的过敏原组分四聚体进行流式细胞术分析以进行CytoBas，同时研究循环Bmem，包括针对Ara h 1、Ara h 2和Ara h 3的荧光四聚体。结果 与Ara h -1、-2、-3、-6、-8过敏原的IgE ELISA相比，CytoBas显示出相似至更优的诊断性能（ROC AUC 0.79-1.0对0.78-0.9）。Ara h 2可将所有患者与对照者区分开，而联合Ara h 1、3和6（排除主要过敏原Ara h 2）可达到78-81%的敏感性和100%的特异性。花生过敏患者在Ara h 1、2和3特异性细胞中显示致病性2型Bmem亚群的扩增，且Ara h 1+和Ara h 3+ Bmem含有扩增的IgG4+和IgG1+亚群。结论 花生CytoBas显示出与组分特异性IgE血清学相似至更优的诊断准确性，能够在单管中高效评估多种过敏原组分。花生过敏个体显示过敏原特异性2型Bmem频率增加，可对其进行纵向评估以监测疾病的自然进程或过敏原免疫治疗。

papers.title: Modeling spontaneous hepatitis C virus clearance by age, sex, IFNL4 genotype, and infection history: Implications for simulations of elimination and vaccine trials
papers.translated_title: 按年龄、性别、IFNL4基因型和感染史建模自发性丙型肝炎病毒清除：对消除模拟和疫苗试验的启示
papers.author: Gandhi, K. R.
papers.summary: Background and Aims: The probability of hepatitis C virus (HCV) clearance is mediated by an interaction between numerous factors. However, variation in spontaneous HCV clearance was previously modeled using relatively simple approaches with fixed probabilities by sex. Here, we developed a literature-informed clearance algorithm that considers age, sex, interferon lambda 4 (IFNL4) genotype, and infection history to model the probability of HCV clearance in vulnerable populations, such as people who inject drugs (PWID), and in controlled human infection (CHI) models for future HCV vaccines. Methods: We modeled HCV clearance probabilities for three infection-history pathways: first infection, reinfection after spontaneous clearance, and reinfection after direct-acting antiviral (DAA) cure. Logistic and cumulative-hazard equations assigned person-specific clearance probabilities in the first two pathways. The post-DAA pathway used fixed clearance probabilities. We tested the algorithm using HepCEP (Hepatitis C Elimination in PWID), an agent-based simulator. Results: First-infection clearance probabilities ranged from 0.13 to 0.51 across eight age, sex, and IFNL4 genotype subgroups. Clearance probabilities for reinfection after spontaneous clearance ranged from 0.20 to 0.80 at literature point estimates. Across 100 runs, the mean assigned clearance probabilities were 0.27 for first infections and 0.52 for reinfections after spontaneous clearance, compared with literature inputs of 0.26 and 0.52, respectively. Probabilities varied across subgroups and runs. Conclusion: Simulations reproduced the algorithm's intended clearance heterogeneity and uncertainty by age, sex, IFNL4 genotype, and infection history, which may support models of HCV elimination in vulnerable populations and CHI model development for future HCV vaccines.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：丙型肝炎病毒（HCV）清除的概率由众多因素之间的相互作用所介导。然而，既往对自发性HCV清除变异性的建模采用的是相对简单的方法，即按性别设定固定概率。在此，我们开发了一种基于文献的清除算法，该算法考虑年龄、性别、干扰素λ4（IFNL4）基因型和感染史，以对脆弱人群（如注射吸毒者，PWID）中以及为未来HCV疫苗开展对照人类感染（CHI）模型中的HCV清除概率进行建模。方法：我们针对三种感染史路径对HCV清除概率进行了建模：首次感染、自发性清除后再感染，以及直接抗病毒药物（DAA）治愈后再感染。前两种路径采用逻辑斯谛和累积风险方程分配个体特异性清除概率。DAA后路径采用固定清除概率。我们使用HepCEP（注射吸毒者丙型肝炎消除）这一基于主体的模拟器对该算法进行了检验。结果：在八个年龄、性别和IFNL4基因型亚组中，首次感染清除概率范围为0.13至0.51。在文献点估计值下，自发性清除后再感染的清除概率范围为0.20至0.80。在100次运行中，平均分配的清除概率为首次感染0.27、自发性清除后再感染0.52，而文献输入值分别为0.26和0.52。各亚组和多次运行之间的概率存在差异。结论：模拟再现了该算法按年龄、性别、IFNL4基因型和感染史所预期的清除异质性和不确定性，这可能为脆弱人群中HCV消除模型以及未来HCV疫苗的CHI模型开发提供支持。

papers.title: Improving UK Biobank algorithms for Parkinson's disease ascertainment using drug claims
papers.translated_title: 利用药物索赔数据改进英国生物银行帕金森病确认算法
papers.author: Kimmerling, V.
papers.summary: Background: Accurate ascertainment of Parkinson's disease (PD) is a major challenge in large-scale epidemiological studies. The UK Biobank (UKB) is widely used for PD research, but ascertainment based on hospital and death records may result in misclassification and delayed PD diagnoses. Objectives: We compared different strategies for ascertaining PD in the UKB, and examined their impact on incidence and associations with risk factors and mortality. Methods: We compared PD ascertained through hospital and death records (ADO-PD) to two approaches that rely on primary care data available for ~45% of participants: diagnoses from general practitioner consultations (Clinical-PD); a novel drug-based algorithm (Drug-PD). We compared incidence, age at diagnosis, and associations with sex, walking speed, and mortality across all algorithms. Results: ADO-PD identified ~20% fewer prevalent and incident cases than Drug-PD over 15y of follow-up, and estimated age at diagnosis to be 4.2y (median) later than age at anti-PD drugs initiation. ADO-PD identified never treated participants or with other causes of parkinsonism as PD patients. While Drug-PD yielded incidence rates consistent with UK reference rates, ADO-PD underestimated incidence by 36% compared to reference rates. Associations with sex, walking speed, and mortality were significantly different for ADO-PD compared to Drug-PD. Clinical-PD and Drug-PD yielded similar findings, although Clinical-PD included patients with other causes of parkinsonism. Conclusions: We draw attention to methodological issues regarding PD ascertainment in the UKB and their consequences. These results can help inform strategies for PD ascertainment by combining multiple data sources, thereby improving the validity of epidemiological analyses.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：准确确定帕金森病（PD）是大规模流行病学研究中的一项重大挑战。英国生物银行（UKB）被广泛用于帕金森病研究，但基于医院和死亡记录的确定可能导致误分类和帕金森病诊断延迟。目的：我们比较了在UKB中确定帕金森病的不同策略，并考察了它们对发病率以及与危险因素和死亡率关联的影响。方法：我们将通过医院和死亡记录确定的帕金森病（ADO-PD）与两种依赖约45%参与者可获得的初级保健数据的方法进行比较：来自全科医生就诊的诊断（Clinical-PD）；一种新的基于药物的算法（Drug-PD）。我们比较了所有算法的发病率、诊断年龄，以及与性别、步行速度和死亡率的关联。结果：在15年随访期间，ADO-PD识别出的患病和 incident 病例比Drug-PD少约20%，并且估计的诊断年龄比开始使用抗帕金森病药物的年龄晚4.2年（中位数）。ADO-PD将从未接受治疗或患有其他帕金森综合征病因的参与者识别为帕金森病患者。虽然Drug-PD得出的发病率与英国参考发病率一致，但与参考发病率相比，ADO-PD将发病率低估了36%。与Drug-PD相比，ADO-PD与性别、步行速度和死亡率的关联存在显著差异。Clinical-PD和Drug-PD得出相似结果，尽管Clinical-PD纳入了患有其他帕金森综合征病因的患者。结论：我们提请注意UKB中帕金森病确定的方法学问题及其后果。这些结果有助于为通过整合多个数据来源确定帕金森病的策略提供信息，从而提高流行病学分析的有效性。
